## Who it suits

| Backend / Systems SWE | Data Scientist / BI | Frontend / Full-Stack | Non-Technical (5+ yrs domain) | PhD / Academic Researcher |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|

Access from each background (0–10): ● ≥7.5 is a high-volume corridor (about 6–8 months at 15–20 hours a week), ◐ 4–7.4 is plausible but extended, ○ below 4 is not plausible within 12 months. These timelines are model outputs (Grade D). For the modelled time to a first offer and the best targets by background, see [GenAI target roles §5](../genai-target-roles.md#5-best-targets-by-background-genai-persona-lenses).

## What you need

- **Must (headline):** Python (production), LLM APIs & tool calling, RAG, Agents & tool use.
- **Important (headline):** Customer scoping & demos, LLM evaluation (golden sets, calibrated judges, CI gates), Guardrails, Prompt & context design, Technical writing, Retrieval quality (hybrid, reranking, recall@k), ML fundamentals, AWS / Azure / GCP, Git & CI/CD, Embeddings & vector search.
- **Full inventory:** 46 skills (Must 4 · Important 16 · Should 14 · Optional 12), each with its evidence and posting keywords: [applied-ai-engineer.md](../../03-skills-and-tech/inventories/applied-ai-engineer.md).
- **Prerequisites:** Lab-tier hiring bar on top of the AI Engineer stack; backend (~6 months) and PhD (~8 months) routes [D · T0-06]
- **Credentials (tie-breakers, not skills):** AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional (AIP-C01) (Optional: services channels). Whether one is worth it: [credential ROI](../../04-certifications/credential-roi.md).
- What to learn first and what to drop across roles: [skills radar](../../03-skills-and-tech/skills-radar.md); in what order: [learning roadmaps](../../03-skills-and-tech/learning-roadmaps.md).

## How to prove it

- **What the evidence asks for:** A customer-facing reference implementation with evals and a published write-up; the AI Engineer T2–T3 portfolio
- **Project archetypes that cover the most of its Must and Important skills** (Grade M): [P1 Evaluated RAG system over a real corpus](../../05-portfolio/project-archetypes.md#p1) (59%); [P2 Reliable agent: approvals, sandboxed tools, replay, failure injection](../../05-portfolio/project-archetypes.md#p2) (34%); [P3 Eval harness with a calibrated judge and statistics](../../05-portfolio/project-archetypes.md#p3) (31%). One project rarely covers a role; [job-search strategy §2.6](../../06-job-search/job-search-strategy.md#26-the-constraints-that-bind-first) computes the smallest sets that do.
- How verifiable the proof must be, and what to publish: [proof-of-work standards](../../05-portfolio/proof-of-work-standards.md).

## How you are interviewed

- **Track: Application.** It tests RAG with access control, agent loop control, evaluation architecture, context management. Source: career/02-roles/role-catalog.md §8.2 (T1-03, T0-14).
- **Practise:** the [application prep pack](../../08-interviewing/prep-packs.md#application-pack), plus the behavioural and coding packs.
- Classify the loop first, then prepare by round: [interview loops](../../08-interviewing/interview-loops.md).

## Résumé

- **Variant:** A2 (Applied GenAI Engineering). Headline pattern: "AI Engineer | LLM systems, RAG, agents, evals".
- **Keywords to mirror, only when true:** applied AI, LLM, customers, evals, deployment, solutions, safety
- **Leave out or reframe:** Generic chatbot demos; no evidence of working with external users
